title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 18640 NW 2nd Avenue in Miami, Florida, as the "Father Richard Marquess-Barry Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 18640 NW 2nd Avenue in Miami, Florida, as the "Father Richard Marquess-Barry Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a Miami, Florida post office building after Father Richard Marquess-Barry.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building at 18640 NW 2nd Avenue in Miami, Florida. The building will be officially called the "Father Richard Marquess-Barry Post Office Building." It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 19, 2014.
